Warm birthday wishes to Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Shri Pema Khandu Ji
On August 21, 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended warm birthday wishes to Arunachal Pradesh Chief Minister Shri Pema Khandu Ji. This heartfelt message not only celebrated Khandu’s special day but also acknowledged his significant contributions to the state.
He has made a mark with his pro-people governance and focus on youth development
Shri Pema Khandu Ji has distinguished himself through his pro-people governance approach. His administration has prioritized the needs and welfare of citizens, ensuring that policies are not just top-down mandates but are built around community needs. Khandu’s focus on youth development is particularly noteworthy. By promoting educational initiatives and entrepreneurship, he has empowered the younger generation, equipping them with skills necessary to thrive in today’s competitive landscape.
May he be blessed with a long and healthy life
As we celebrate Khandu’s birthday, it’s essential to reflect on the positive impact he has had on Arunachal Pradesh. His vision for a prosperous state is rooted in sustainable development, cultural preservation, and economic growth. Wishing him a long and healthy life aligns with the aspirations of the people of Arunachal Pradesh, who look forward to his continued leadership.
In summary, the warm birthday wishes from Narendra Modi to Shri Pema Khandu Ji highlight the importance of supportive leadership in the region. With a commitment to pro-people governance and youth development, Khandu’s role as Chief Minister remains crucial for the state’s future. Happy birthday, Shri Pema Khandu Ji!
For more insights into his governance and initiatives, you can follow him on Twitter at @PemaKhanduBJP.
